summary: Verified live-data-first camera proxy + diagnostics contract. Added coverage for GET /api/, /api/camera/diagnostics, /api/camera/stream and system/health.camera_online in both LIVE and OFFLINE states. 17/17 backend tests pass. Frontend /live and / (Dashboard) render live stream via /api/camera/stream with diagnostics all OK; OFFLINE state renders pi-offline-banner + camera-stream-unavailable + diagnostics FAIL and empty-state; no demo-tag or Jane Doe/Front Porch/packages leakage. Mock Pi RESTARTED after offline test and is running at end.
critical_code_review_comments: pi_client.resolve_video_url probes 9 candidate paths — good discovery UX; PI_VIDEO_URL env override respected.
/api/camera/stream and /api/pi/stream share _camera_stream_response — single implementation, both return 503 on failure.
diagnostics() force-refreshes video URL every call — appropriate for on-demand UI panel; separate 5s cache used elsewhere.
camera_online in /system/health derives from video_reachable OR normalized cameras_online — resilient when /status returns no cameras array but MJPEG works.
CameraLive.jsx correctly uses same-origin streamUrl(); imgError -> camera-stream-unavailable data-testid renders as expected offline.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run backend tests with `-o addopts=''` to bypass pytest-xdist parallelism in /app/backend/pytest.ini (LIVE/OFFLINE share mock Pi process state). Mock Pi harness: start=`cd /app && setsid nohup python tools/mock_pi.py >/tmp/mockpi.log 2>&1 < /dev/null &`, stop=`pkill -f mock_pi.py` (wait 6s for 5s diagnostics cache). Live-verified testids: camera-live-panel, camera-stream-img (src=/api/camera/stream), camera-diagnostics, cam-stream-picam0, cam-stream-usb1, live-event-live-1, live-event-live-2. Offline-verified testids: pi-offline-banner, camera-stream-unavailable, empty-state. demo-tag testid is NEVER present.
